Adds a gate so the loop knows when work counts as done. No feature work.

## The gate

| Step | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| build | `npm run build` | pass |
| test | `npm test` | 33 pass, 0 fail |

## Supporting changes

- `next.config.ts` reads `distDir` from an environment variable.
- `.gitignore` keeps the gate file.

An independent review found nothing blocking.
